name: Stefan Bajcetic

career_stints.note: Senior Liverpool first-team appearances since his August 2022 debut. Last first-team appearance was May 2024, before a series of loan moves and a long-term hamstring injury kept him out of the squad ever since.

Season-long loan (from Aug 2024) cut short by a recall; includes 6 Champions League appearances. Reunited with former Liverpool assistant Pepijn Lijnders, then Salzburg's head coach. Goals/assists not reliably verifiable, omitted rather than guessed.

La Liga loan from 31 January 2025 (12 starts of 21 appearances); scored his only goal for the club 16 Feb 2025 vs Mallorca. One earlier-dated source gave a much smaller in-progress figure ('four appearances, one goal') -- treated as a stale mid-loan snapshot rather than the final total, since the 21-appearance figure comes from a more complete end-of-window source. A hamstring injury in the closing weeks of this loan (May 2025) ended his season and required surgery.

notes: injury_status taken directly from data/squad/liverpool_2026_27.json as instructed, not independently re-derived. Context found in research: the hamstring injury originated at the end of his Las Palmas loan (May 2025), required surgery, kept him out of the entirety of the 2025/26 season, and as of late July 2026 he was still not training with the first team -- consistent with the 'Doubtful' status in the squad file.

playstyle_metrics left entirely null: his most recent action (Las Palmas, first half of 2025) is over a year old at the time of writing and no per-90 advanced stats for that loan spell were found in an accessible source. Given the long injury layoff, no in-season 2025/26 or 2026/27 data exists to use instead.

position_estimate.basis is 'prior_club_recent_minutes' using the Las Palmas loan as the most recent (though now stale) playing sample, since he has no current-season Liverpool minutes and his return timeline is unresolved ('Doubtful'). Confidence is low (0.35) given the long layoff and uncertainty about his role/fitness on eventual return.
